files.title: Document URLs
files.description: Direct links to the documents. Word (DOC, DOCX), Excel (XLS, XLSX, CSV), PowerPoint (PPT, PPTX, PPS), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP) and RTF.

outputFormat.title: Convert to
outputFormat.description: PDF for every kind of document, or another editable format of the same kind (Word ↔ ODT, Excel ↔ ODS, PowerPoint ↔ ODP). Plain text is TXT for documents and CSV (one file per sheet) for spreadsheets.

pdfA.title: PDF/A (archiving)
pdfA.description: Write PDF/A-2b, the archival PDF many courts, tenders and government portals ask for.

onePagePerSheet.title: Spreadsheets: one page per sheet
onePagePerSheet.description: Fit each whole sheet on a single PDF page instead of splitting it over printed pages.

includeNotes.title: Presentations: add speaker notes pages
includeNotes.description: Append a notes page for every slide after the slides.

imageQuality.title: JPEG quality of pictures (%)
imageQuality.description: Recompress pictures inside the PDF at this quality and at most 300 DPI, for smaller files. Leave empty to keep them as they are.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).

timeoutSecs.title: Time limit per document (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: A document that takes longer is skipped with an error (not charged).
